activity_summary: About nine a sound began to the south-east that was not bells. A boy cried a thousand on Tower Hill, with warders among them. You saw none of it. You and Mistress Ansell dropped the street-door bar and spoke of it as an ordinary night, tired of the heat. She will have no light in the front. She asked whether the upstairs candle was remembered. It is yours, and it is the only light in the house. Gillis went up to the garret without a word. Alse is to sleep in her mistress's chamber. You said you would bar your own door.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the sound, took the other end of the bar, and kept the talk ordinary.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Set Alse into her chamber, barred the street door, and forbade a light in the front.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Looked once, failed to see the crowd, and went up to the truckle.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Went to the garret without a word, and stayed out of the lane.

facets.activity: Took the other end of the bar

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The bar, Master Shakespeare. Take the other end

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Every night, Mistress. Tonight it is only heavier, and we will not say so

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It is mine, Mistress. It is the only light in the house

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: There. If anyone in the close asks, we were tired of the heat
